tour.viewerText: We built this section from what you shared. Each item shows where it came from. If something's missing, add a source and we'll update it. You don't need to write it yourself.
tour.sourceText: Add a link or upload a brand document. Then press Update Brand Core before you ask for a review.
tour.label: Discovery guide
tour.brandText: Add your website, or documents if you don't have one. For a new brand, just type its name. You share, we write.
tour.referencesText: Add a link, choose current brand, desired direction or competitive context, then explain what matters: typography, photography, tone or positioning. Reference brands never become your current brand facts.
tour.filesText: Use foundations for brand documents, visual for design examples, and voice for writing samples. Choose current or desired direction. Files must be 15 MB or smaller; any upload problem appears beside the affected file.
tour.generateText: Select Generate Brand Core once your sources are ready. We upload files first and start discovery only after uploads succeed. Generation can take several minutes. You will review the result before confirming it.
tour.reviewText: Open each section to see what we found and where it came from. Fix anything wrong, or add a source for what's missing. If you don't know something, leave it blank.
tour.chapterText: Check what we wrote against what you know. Mark facts as Right and plans as A goal. Leave unknowns blank. Go back to all sections when you're done.
tour.confirmTitle: Confirm only what you can support
tour.confirmText: Review the confirmation statements. Confirm the Brand Core only if you are authorized, it represents the brand, and desired directions are marked separately. You can save and return later.

greeting.home: *Briefing a new flow lives in the launchpad above.* Use this for status, advice, or anything you'd ask a CMO mid-week.
greeting.discovery: *You're mid-extraction.* I'm reading the site in another tab. Ask me anything while we wait — including 'what should I check first when it lands'.
greeting.bio: *The Brand Core is the canon.* I'll quote it back if you ask me about a field. Ask me what's weak.
greeting.briefs: *Three briefs in flight, four shipped.* Ask me about any one of them, or ask me which one I'd push first this week.
greeting.briefDetail: *You're inside a brief.* I can take you through the SMP, the refusals, or what I'd do differently if we were writing it tomorrow.
greeting.specialists: *That's your department.* Ask me who I'd assemble for a specific job, and I'll show you the pick + why.
greeting.canvas: *This is the workspace.* The map gets denser as you ship. Ask me about any node, or ask me what's downstream of the Brand Core.
greeting.craft: *Hand work the team should finish.* I'll match a finishing pack to a job if you describe it.
greeting.credits: *Spend, not budget.* Ask me where the money went, or what would change if you doubled the cycle.
greeting.settings: *Workspace governance.* Ask me what the forbidden list should be, or whether your auto-approve threshold is loose.
greeting.default: *I'm Brandolph.* Ask me what's in progress, what's stuck or what to do next. Asking is free. You'll see the cost before any brief runs.
